name: GetUiElementDetails
label: Get UI Element Details
description: Get information like position, text, or state from a UI element in a window.

fields.name: IdentificationObjectPath
fields.label: UI Element
fields.description: The UI element from which you want to retrieve details.

fields.name: DetailType
fields.label: Detail Type
fields.description: Choose what information you want to get from the UI element.

selectOptions.label: Bounding Rectangle
selectOptions.description: Get the bounding rectangle of the element.

selectOptions.label: Clickable Point
selectOptions.description: Get the clickable point of the element.

selectOptions.label: Label Text
selectOptions.description: Get the text from a label element.

selectOptions.label: Is Enabled
selectOptions.description: Check if the element is enabled.

selectOptions.label: Is Offscreen
selectOptions.description: Check if the element is offscreen (not visible to the user).

selectOptions.label: Is Password
selectOptions.description: Check if the element is a password field.

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait to find the UI element (in seconds).

fields.name: BoundingRectangle
fields.label: Bounding Rectangle
fields.description: The bounding rectangle of the UI element, if applicable.

fields.name: ClickablePoint
fields.label: Clickable Point
fields.description: The clickable point of the UI element, if applicable.

fields.name: LabelText
fields.label: Label Text
fields.description: The text of the label or element, if applicable.

fields.name: IsEnabled
fields.label: Is Enabled
fields.description: True if the UI element is enabled, otherwise false.

fields.name: IsOffscreen
fields.label: Is Offscreen
fields.description: True if the UI element is offscreen, otherwise false.

fields.name: IsPassword
fields.label: Is Password
fields.description: True if the UI element is a password field, otherwise false.
